definitions.short: to issue , i.e. furnish ; causatively, to secure ; figuratively, to succeed
definitions.usage: afford, draw out, further, get, obtain.
definitions.full: H6329. puq II. מּוּק verb Hiph`il bring out, furnish, promote (Late Hebrew id. ; apparently akin to Aramaic נְפַק go forth , Aph`el bring forth, produce ); — 1 produce, furnish: Imperfect (jussive) לָרָעֵב וְתָפֵק Isa 58:10 with נַפְשְׁךָ (read perhaps לַחְמְךָ see Che Hpt ); Participle אֶלזַֿן מִזַּן מְפִיקִים Psa 144:13 (see זַן ). 2 bring out, elicit, obtain , with accusative; יָפִיק Prov 3:13 , + מִן person, וַיָּפֶק 8:35 ; 18:22 (all || מצא ), 12:2 . 3 אַלתָּֿפֵק זְמָמוֺ Psa 140:9 his device do not promote.
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root [rather identical with 6328 through the idea of dropping out; compare 5312 ];
